summary: GLR is ready to move quickly, beginning with conventional and affordable properties currently in Rent Manager while planning the RealPage exit. First-property setup should emphasize role-based security, separate resident/subsidy ledgers, affordable applications and compliance approvals, ordered affordable waitlists, complete lead-source attribution, supported payment methods, and reliable maintenance assignment. Several detailed policies—especially payment-fee handling, waitlist response time, user roles, and repayment terms—still need confirmation.
